title: Ulla, son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 42a regarding a halakhic matter, and Rava raises a difficulty against him.[^1]

notes.text: מב. gives Bava Kamma 42a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Ulla is untitled in the supplied source, despite catalog metadata. Idi’s Rav is full; Rava is a personal name. Rava raises the difficulty against Ulla.
